item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 23/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. With the strengthening of an anticyclone aloft, it will be brighter over the coastal areas of southern China early this week. The northeast monsoon is expected to affect Guangdong midweek this week.

Date/Month: 23/04 (Sunday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two showers. Visibility rather low in some areas at first. Bright periods during the day.
Temp range: 22 - 26 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
